versions.subject: feat: new rules, updates and goofy guineapig stuff (#4229)
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\excel.exe'
    ImageLoaded|contains:
        # Note: Add or remove locations from this list based on your internal policy
        - '\Desktop\'
        - '\Downloads\'
        - '\Perflogs\'
        - '\Temp\'
        - '\Users\Public\'
        - '\Windows\Tasks\'
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '.xll'
condition: selection
